content: आयस्त {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} [यस्-क्त] .²1 Pained, distressed, afflicted. .²2 Hurt, injured, killed; नित्यायस्तो बालको (न ईशे) <ls>Mb. 13. 1. 26</ls>. .²3 Vexed, angry. .²4 Effected with difficulty. .²5 Thrown, cast, sent forth. .²6 Sharpened, whetted. .²7 (Actively used) Toiling, labouring, exerting oneself. .²8 Eager, anxiously desirous; आयस्तः (संप्राप्तुम्) <ls>Ki. 7. 32</ls>. .{@-स्तम्@} A great effort; न मे गर्वितमायस्तं सहिष्यति दुरात्मवान् <ls>Rām. 4. 16. 9</ls>.
